name: Detecting Fraud In Blockchain Transactions
model: Graph Node Feature Aggregator + One-Class SVM
description: Cryptocurrency transaction fraud detection module identifying wash trading, mixing patterns, and illicit wallet interactions.
limitations: Rapidly evolving cryptographic obfuscation mixers and cross-chain hops may evade single-chain heuristics.
responsible_use_notes: Supports AML (Anti-Money Laundering) compliance research; outputs require human forensic validation.
